headline.text: L1 Sollich 2 labeler problems forced WIP production overnight and left *11 pallets in rework* — team switched to backup labeler but issues persisted through shift end.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 fought labeler issues all night — bubbles and wrinkles forced a switch to backup labeler B, which also struggled. Sollich 3 had two brief temper pauses but recovered both times. Equipment on all three lines failed allergen swabs and needed re-clean.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 wrapped belt testing successfully after maintenance corrected drift and sensor faults. Truffle line completed level 2 clean and milk changeover for Monday. One process flag: mesh found running during reheat, program not saved correctly.

notes.text: Caustic restocked from Orem warehouse — last barrel on site as of 01:16.
Correct pallets for Matrix line arrived and staged for Monday startup.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 tempering delay after reheat
resolved.summary: Line held for 30 minutes waiting on temper after reheat completed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:58 — "The line is back in production" (S3 Enrober).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 jar shortage paused line
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 15:29 waiting for jars to arrive.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 16:00 — line resumed production based on subsequent updates.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 lost temper on overnight shift
resolved.summary: Line paused at 18:57 due to lost temper, resumed within 6 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:03 — "We are resuming the line" (S3 Enrober).

resolved.title: Caustic supply depleted
resolved.summary: L1 ran out of caustic during overnight cleaning operations.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:16 — "We brought the barrel of caustic from orem warehouse to L1. It is the last one we have." (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: Missing COA for inbound materials
resolved.summary: Receiving blocked on two shipments due to missing certificates of analysis and incomplete documentation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:46 — "the correct COA and PO # was just sent via email" (Kirk Nickel).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 unspecified maintenance fault
resolved.summary: Issue flagged during first shift, maintenance called in.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:18 — "Maintenance has corrected the issue" (Caleb York).

resolved.title: ML1 belt drift and sensor faults during testing
resolved.summary: C5 drifted north, Belt 200 loose, Belt 240 had sensor fault and tension issue during pre-startup belt testing.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:43 — "Belts ran successfully after being fixed. They ran for 15 minutes with no issues." (Phillip Perez). Efrain confirmed at 17:20: "All belts are running good every sensor was adjusted."

resolved.title: Depositor 3 leak from missing gasket
resolved.summary: Depositor fitting leaked due to missing gasket on ML4 line.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 06:54 — "Depositor 3 leak fixed fitting was missing a gasket" (Rose Smuin, acknowledging Jose Vasquez repair).

resolved.title: Depositor 2 circuit fault
resolved.summary: Circuit #2 fault flagged on depositor 2, cause unknown initially.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:42 — "The O ring was missing .I put a new one ." (Jose Vasquez).

resolved.title: Truffle Line coconut oil solid in staging
resolved.summary: Staged coconut oil mostly solid, team unsure if correct brand, needed access to warm room tote.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:51 — "We used the Columbus brand we usually use." (Kimberly Morales).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 labeler causing bubbles, wrinkles, and rework
needs_attention.summary: Primary labeler failed with bubbles and wrinkles starting at 18:56, team switched to labeler B but issues persisted — line ran into WIP, 11 pallets marked rework by shift end.
needs_attention.status: Line producing WIP as of 21:29, 11 pallets in rework status at 22:58 — labeler B "can't keep up and labeling one jar and not the one after."

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 HMI potential corruption
needs_attention.summary: Eaglestone tech scheduled to remote in and diagnose whether HMI is corrupted.
needs_attention.status: Awaiting vendor remote diagnostic as of 15:31, no update posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 allergen test failures on clean equipment
needs_attention.summary: C19, C20, C26, and Zbelt failed allergen swabs and required re-cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Re-clean initiated at 07:48, no confirmation posted on pass results by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line belt missing nuts and bolts
needs_attention.summary: Small crossover belt missing hardware on one side, flagged to maintenance.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 23:05, no confirmation of repair by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line mesh running during reheat
needs_attention.summary: Bottomer and enrober found on reheat with mesh belt still running — program not saved to disable mesh during reheat mode.
needs_attention.status: Confirmed at 23:39 that program setting not saved correctly — requires operator awareness until program corrected.
